dependencies_source_ref_check.name: dependencies_source_ref_check
dependencies_source_ref_check.value:
("dependencies"."source_type" = 'agent' and "dependencies"."source_agent_id" is not null and "dependencies"."source_resource_id" is null)
        or ("dependencies"."source_type" = 'resource' and "dependencies"."source_resource_id" is not null and "dependencies"."source_agent_id" is null)

dependencies_target_ref_check.name: dependencies_target_ref_check
dependencies_target_ref_check.value:
("dependencies"."target_type" = 'agent' and "dependencies"."target_agent_id" is not null and "dependencies"."target_resource_id" is null)
        or ("dependencies"."target_type" = 'resource' and "dependencies"."target_resource_id" is not null and "dependencies"."target_agent_id" is null)

dependencies_type_matrix_check.name: dependencies_type_matrix_check
dependencies_type_matrix_check.value:
("dependencies"."dependency_type" = 'authority' and "dependencies"."source_type" = 'agent' and "dependencies"."target_type" = 'agent')
        or ("dependencies"."dependency_type" = 'resource' and "dependencies"."source_type" = 'agent' and "dependencies"."target_type" = 'resource')
        or ("dependencies"."dependency_type" = 'operational' and not ("dependencies"."source_type" = 'resource' and "dependencies"."target_type" = 'resource'))
